monster:goblin.visualDescription: A small green-faced humanoid has a gray helmet, red mouth, ragged brown clothing, and a small dark weapon.
monster:goblin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the goblin as a small basic orc-type humanoid that uses weapons.
monster:goblin.modelBrief: Build a short green goblin with oversized helmet, thin limbs, ragged brown clothing, and a compact weapon.

monster:hobgoblin.visualDescription: A taller red-brown humanoid has a square gray helmet, dark face, raised weapon, and long legs.
monster:hobgoblin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the hobgoblin as a strong orc-type monster tougher than a goblin.
monster:hobgoblin.modelBrief: Enlarge the goblin silhouette into a leaner, taller soldier with red-brown skin, gray helm, and clearly raised weapon.

monster:orc.visualDescription: A green-gray armored humanoid shows a long jaw, dark helmet, broad shoulder, and a curved gray blade.
monster:orc.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the orc monster as the base orc counterpart for playable orcs.
monster:orc.modelBrief: Build a lean armored orc with green face, dark metal helm, brown clothing, and curved blade; preserve its forward stride.

monster:hill orc.visualDescription: A tall olive-skinned soldier wears a gray helmet and blue-gray upper armor, with a brown lower garment and raised blade.
monster:hill orc.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a strong orc that seeks gold, gems, and other equipment.
monster:hill orc.modelBrief: Use an armored orc body with olive skin, gray helm, blue-gray shoulder armor, and one lifted sword.

monster:Mordor orc.visualDescription: A dark olive warrior has a gray-blue helmet, brown clothing, long limbs, and a curved dark weapon.
monster:Mordor orc.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Mordor orc as a slightly stronger but slower orc form.
monster:Mordor orc.modelBrief: Make a darker, heavier armored orc with helmet, long crooked blade, and brown lower clothing; separate it from the hill orc by tone and posture.

monster:Uruk-hai.visualDescription: A dark red-brown orc wears a gray helmet and broad blue-gray shield while holding a curved blade.
monster:Uruk-hai.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Uruk-hai as strong orcs, faster than Mordor orcs.
monster:Uruk-hai.modelBrief: Build a robust shield-bearing orc with gray helm, dark reddish body, and curved sword; make the shield prominent.

monster:orc shaman.visualDescription: A pale olive orc in earth-toned robes raises a staff topped with a gray ornament, with bright eyes and a small headpiece.
monster:orc shaman.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the orc shaman as an orc that casts monster spells.
monster:orc shaman.modelBrief: Model a lean robe-clad orc holding a tall ritual staff, pale olive skin, and distinct headpiece; keep the magical role readable.

monster:orc-captain.visualDescription: A broad dark armored orc has a blue-gray face or mask, a round shield, layered armor, and a raised forked blade.
monster:orc-captain.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the orc-captain as the strongest orc type with two weapon attacks.
monster:orc-captain.modelBrief: Make a heavily armored commander with dark cloak, round shield, imposing helmet or mask, and large weapon.

monster:rock piercer.visualDescription: A brown horizontal stalactite-like shell points forward above a pink fleshy mouth and dark rear body.
monster:rock piercer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki groups rock piercers with ceiling-hiding carnivorous piercers that drop onto passersby; their shell resembles a stalactite.
monster:rock piercer.modelBrief: Shape an earthy stone cone or pointed shell around a fleshy pink mouth; allow a ceiling-clinging pose and keep the mouth exposed.

monster:iron piercer.visualDescription: A steel-gray pointed shell projects ahead of a dark body, with a pink fleshy opening at the rear.
monster:iron piercer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the iron piercer as one of three ceiling-hiding piercers with a biting body and stalactite-like shell.
monster:iron piercer.modelBrief: Reuse the piercer body plan with a hard gray metallic tapered shell, dark underside, and visible pink mouth.

monster:glass piercer.visualDescription: A white-cyan crystalline pointed shell has blue facets, red accents, and a pink mouth beneath it.
monster:glass piercer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the glass piercer as a ceiling-hiding member of the piercer group.
monster:glass piercer.modelBrief: Build a clear angular glasslike cone over the fleshy piercer mouth, using icy blue facets and a few red details from the tile.

monster:rothe.visualDescription: A shaggy red-brown quadruped has a broad bull-like head, green eyes, thick legs, and a raised ridged back.
monster:rothe.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the rothe as a large omnivorous quadruped with claw and bite attacks.
monster:rothe.modelBrief: Sculpt a bulky, low beast with heavy forequarters, rough rust-brown fur ridges, broad muzzle, and strong paws.
